channel.title: DECODED: THE AI CONVERSATIONS
channel.desc: AI is no longer a technology of the future; it is a current reality reshaping our daily lives and entire industries. In the conversation among the MC, the panelist, and the guests, complex AI concepts are naturally \"decoded\" into everyday language.
